cover_headline: Indiaspora Warns Targeting H-1B Holders Poses 'Very Serious' Risk to US Economy

end.headline: Indiaspora Warns Targeting H-1B Holders Poses 'Very Serious' Risk to US Economy
end.line: The diaspora organisation's October 30 statement flagged five proposed curbs — and urged US leaders to reject anti-Indian rhetoric ahead of the midterms.

facts: Indian nationals received 71% of approved H-1B visas in FY24
The $100,000 H-1B petition payment is already in force and has been extended to September 21, 2027
Indiaspora flagged five proposed measures, including scrapping the 60-day grace period and freezing H-4 spousal work permits

quote.speaker: Sanjeev Joshipura
quote.text: H-1B workers from India have helped make America the world's innovation leader, generating billions for the American economy. Driving them away could have very serious consequences for communities nationwide, from major cities to small towns.
